title: Environmental Management for Cities and Industrial Estates

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and characteristics of urban areas and industrial estates.
Identify and analyze environmental issues in urban areas and industrial estates.
Apply waste management techniques in urban environments.
Implement water management strategies in urban settings.
Develop strategies for controlling air pollution in urban areas.
Manage climate change impacts on urban environments.
Manage environmental aspects of industrial estates.
Promote energy efficiency in industrial estates.
Implement sustainable practices in urban and industrial environments.
